name: Highwealth Construction Corp.
description: Highwealth Construction Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, construction, leasing, and sale of residential and commercial buildings in Taiwan. It operates through the Construction, and Hotels and Other Department segments. The company offers real estate agency brokerage and trading; and catering services. It also engages in the operation of hotels; wholesale of building materials; general investment activities; and other business operations. Highwealth Construction Corp. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
